data.body: PLANNING_CONSIDERATION (from preplanning Phase E adversarial review): Done Definitions must enumerate all 6 integration sub-tests by name: (a) session-timeout query returns entry tagged auth/forms; (b) --tier=summary output has ### Summary, no ### Implementation; (c) manifest integrity check; (d) no corpus file exceeds 500 lines; (e) precision sub-test: USWDS form validation, WCAG 2.2 keyboard navigation, government authentication anti-pattern queries each return a top result with matching frontmatter tags; (f) completes within 10 seconds. Reconcile with bdb4-3211: precision sub-test (e) for USWDS form validation depends on bdb4-3211 shipping first.
